name: US–China / Taiwan
value: 30 PLA aircraft near Taiwan in day to 13 Nov
summary: Taiwan reported 30 PLA aircraft and 8 warships nearby in 24h to 13 Nov and says China rehearsed attacks on its cities
state: Taiwan's defence ministry reported 30 Chinese military aircraft, eight naval vessels and three other official ships around Taiwan in the 24 hours to 13 Nov, and a senior security official told Reuters that China rehearsed attacks on Taiwanese cities in unannounced drills in early November (Kyiv Post). Defence Minister Wellington Koo said on 10 Nov that a carrier group was running area-denial drills in the Western Pacific (ThePrint). Trump and Xi are due to meet at APEC in Shenzhen on 18–19 Nov. No blockade, quarantine or clash was found, so Watch holds.
for_you: Shipping, airlines and firms with supply chains through the Taiwan Strait are most exposed to drills and route changes. Travellers can check FCDO travel advice for Taiwan and China.
rubric_hit: Watch: large-scale PLA activity around Taiwan (30 aircraft, 8 warships in 24h to 13 Nov); no blockade or clash
